title: Vintage PlayStation Official Travel Messenger Bag Case, PS1/PS2
categoryName: Video Games & Consoles:Video Game Accessories:Bags, Skins & Travel Cases
descriptionText:
This vintage PlayStation travel messenger bag case is the perfect accessory for any gaming enthusiast. With its sleek black nylon material, it is durable and stylish enough to carry around your console and games. The bag is officially licensed and features the iconic PlayStation branding.

The unit type is a unit, and the model is VTG PlayStation. It is compatible with console and games, making it the ideal bag for anyone who loves to travel while gaming. This bag is suitable for all occasions and is a must-have for any PlayStation fan.
